title: Apple's forgotten co-founder sold 10% for $800
caption:
Apple had three founders in 1976. Ronald Wayne owned 10%.
Twelve days later he sold his stake for $800.
10% of Apple's value today is about {cap:AAPL*0.10}.
comment: Would you have kept the 10%? Be honest 👇
sources: Ronald Wayne interviews (Reuters 2011, BBC 2013): sold for $800, no regrets
Apple market value: Yahoo Finance, at render time

scenes.say: In nineteen seventy-six, Apple had three founders. You know two of them.
Ronald Wayne owned ten percent of the company.
Twelve days later, he sold it back for eight hundred dollars.
Ten percent of Apple today is worth about {cap:AAPL*0.10}.
He has said he doesn't regret it.
